summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with a focus on high-performance and parallel systems: CUDA kernel optimization with memory coalescing, MPI work-distribution and scheduling on SLURM-managed clusters, and performance porting of inference workloads across x86 and ARM/Jetson SoCs. Strong C++ systems fundamentals backed by hands-on profiling, memory management, and multi-threaded task coordination.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16/19 and ResNet-50 backbones; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Built a custom image-stitching pipeline using bit manipulation and averaging, achieving a PSNR of 65 over a homography baseline.
Combined optimized homography stitching with concurrency and a custom wavelet bank for noise suppression, reaching a PSNR of 86.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.
Coalesced kernel ran at 49.2ms vs 73.3ms (uncoalesced) and 77.5ms (CPU) - ~35% faster than naive GPU and 1.5-2x on convolution, at identical accuracy.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Implemented and benchmarked four parallel work-distribution strategies (static strip/block/cyclic, dynamic task queue) for 5000x5000 scenes using MPI.
Reached up to 30x speedup with static strip partitioning (55 processes); the dynamic task queue outperformed all static methods under unpredictable workloads.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Ported perception onto a Jetson ARM SoC with TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup: 56.7 to 10.9 ms) across a three-layer distributed WebSocket pipeline.
Built a multiprocessing multi-camera capture pipeline; resolved 11 integration failures to reach 100% pick reliability (10/10) at ~11.5s latency.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination across concurrent sensing, control, and display tasks on STM32, with interrupt-driven UART and Jetson-side YOLOv8 tracking.
